runtime.scope: 60 distinct recorded observations at2Hz, actual 16x5Hz RGB and named state histories; replay timestamps rebased to wall clock; synchronized real encoder and new checkpoint. Decode/capture/transport excluded. Existing OpenPI provider .8/K2, no action inference or robot.
